Tech docs — Abstractions catalog

Every reusable element, in one place.

Two kinds of code exist here: a reusable element, or configuration composing one. This page is the inventory of the first kind — types, components, widgets, libraries and modules — so a change reaches for what already exists before it writes something new.

The web-ui and native-C halves below are curated by hand, because typedoc reads TSDoc, not Vue single-file components or C headers. The @openmixer/core and @openmixer/server halves are generated straight from their TSDoc comments — 2191 exported symbols, 2019 of them with a summary.

Composables — packages/web-ui

useResource

The one write/read client for a REST row: optimistic hold, refusal surfacing, supersede-by-later-write.

useContract

Reads a row's declared OPTIONS contract — the writable fields, ranges and enumerated options.

useStripRow

Write-backed binding to one channel strip's row.

strip-view-store

Read-only per-channel row binding, split out to break an import cycle with useStripRow.

row-store-registry

The central registry every declared row store joins, so a test can reset every store and stream in one call.

useVisibleDemand

Turns a widget's on-screen visibility into the demand signal that lets nothing compute unwatched.

useConsoleStream

The one EventSource connection to the console — every SSE stream in the surface goes through it.

useNumberFormat

Locale-aware numeric display formatting.

useDeclaration

Reads a resource's declared schema and limits.

useTraceDemand

Demand-gates a trace-buffer subscription.

useScreenClass

Responsive breakpoint classification.

useTheme

Reads the active theme's tokens.

useControlDescriptor

Generic control metadata — label, unit and range — for a declared field.

Components & widgets — packages/web-ui

ConfirmButton

Arm-then-fire two-tap confirmation for an unrecoverable action, including the global no-confirmation escape hatch.

db.ts / FADER_TAPER

The one canonical fader position↔dB taper, shared by the fader widget, the channel tile and the model.

controls/Fader.vue

The base fader widget — taper, drag and keyboard nudge — wrapped by the gain fader and the fader bank.

controls/Encoder.vue, EncoderRow.vue

A rotary parameter control, alone or as a labelled row.

controls/Meter.vue

The per-strip level meter.

controls/ConsoleSelect.vue

A styled select control with contrast handling built in.

Stepper.vue

A stepped +/- numeric control.

NudgeField.vue

A numeric field with nudge buttons.

SchemaForm.vue / SchemaField.vue

Generic form rendering from a declared schema.

C libraries — packages/pipewire-native

mix_dsp.h

The shared DSP kernel library: click-free gain ramps, gate/EQ/compressor primitives, bus summing, output delay and the real-FFT analyser.

mixer_state.h

The node's state layout and its concurrency contract — which fields are word-atomic, real-time-owned, or release/acquire.

omx_napi.h / .c

The one JS-boundary argument-fetch-and-validate shape every native binding declares its signature through.

mix_bus.h

The summing bus: width folding, sparsity skipping, one send struct for every bus in the desk.

mix_lane.h

The one processing-lane stage walk shared verbatim by every channel strip and the master lane.

mix_order.h

The data-driven, allocation-free per-strip stage order — a reorderable chain of gate, EQ, compressor, delay, reverb and insert steps.

mix_host.h

The addon's one shared, refcounted PipeWire client and thread loop.

mix_delay.h

The real-time-safe stereo delay-line kernel, used as a send/return or an insert.

mix_reverb.h

One Schroeder-Moorer comb-and-allpass kernel serving both room and hall reverbs, plus a Dattorro plate kernel.

mix_tap.h

The named tap-point bank: post-trim, pre-EQ, post-EQ, pre-fader, post-fader.

mix_insert.h

The in-lane hosted-plugin send/return detour.

mix_rec.h

The real-time-safe capture ring: monotonic cursors, a counted gap standing in for silence.

mix_pb.h

The playback ring counterpart to mix_rec.h — lockstep multitrack reads, silence on a stall.

mix_loop.h

Routing-loop (howl-round) graph detection, kept as the one topology mirror in the codebase.

mix_rf64.h

The WAV/RF64 grammar — the single writer and reader for every take file.

hrp_baseline.h, hrp_attribute.h, hrp_pitch.h, hrp_track.h, hrp_analyze.c

The composed HRP (harmonic reference pitch) pipeline: pitch, then attribution, then baseline, then tracking, one contract per stage.

generator.h / .c

Talkback and test-signal source nodes, sharing mix_host.h's client.

Resource molds — packages/core, instantiated from packages/server

DerivedResource

A read-only row recomputed on every read.

ScalarRecordResource

One writable scalar or record per address.

CollectionResource

An addressable multi-item collection, such as a set of EQ bands.

LatchResource

Momentary or latched state, extending ScalarRecordResource.

OperationResource

An action-style, POST-shaped resource.

ConsoleResource<S>

The umbrella interface every row satisfies, for the rare row that needs more than a mold provides.

stripFieldRow()

A generic builder that turns a strip field, its wire codec and its engine door into a full row.

StripStateController<...>

The shared base behind the compressor, delay, reverb and gate controllers.

Controllers — packages/server

State plus a broadcastable frame, with no I/O of their own.

BpmControllerClockControllerCompControllerDelayControllerDiscoveryControllerGateControllerHeadAmpLifecycleControllerRecordControllerReverbControllerRmeTotalmixControllerSafetyControllerStripStateControllerVscControllerWarningsController

Stores — packages/server

Persisted state, one module per concern.

ChannelConfigStoreChannelEqStoreChannelPatchStoreClockOwnershipStoreJsonSettingsStoreMeasurementStoreNetworkSettingsStorePatchbaySettingsStorePatchStoreReacConfigStoreSceneStoreSessionStoreTakeStoreTouchedStore

Transport — packages/server

protocol.ts

Every outbound wire frame shape, each with its own builder function — the one declared home for what goes out on the wire.

rest-router.ts

The single REST door. It names no entity itself, which is what lets every row be plain configuration instead of wiring its own HTTP verbs.

Generated — core + server

The TypeScript public surface.
